answer: Every agent identity is a vertex in a funding graph, and the ledger records the edge by which its stake arrived. Identities drawing capital from one shared inlet are treated as a single cluster whose total vote weight is capped at what one honest participant could hold, regardless of how many wallets it spawned. New identities also sit in a dawn phase for their first week at near-zero weight, so a sybil farm pays full price per identity while its influence stays near zero until genuinely separated stake accumulates.
